fields.label: Region
fields.description: Atlas region to build in. Also Garage's S3 region name.

fields.label: Base Image
fields.description: Image every machine boots from.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Draft
Pending
Machines Ready
Credentials Minted
Active
Failed
fields.description:
Draft — nothing asked for yet.
Pending — Atlas has the machines, still booting.
Machines Ready — all machines up and reachable.
Credentials Minted — secrets issued, ready to configure.
Active — Garage is running and Central can use it.

fields.label: Error
fields.description: Why the last step failed.

fields.label: Topology
fields.description: Machine count and how safely data is spread.

fields.label: Storage Nodes
fields.description: Machines holding data. A gateway is always added, so 3 here builds 4 machines.

fields.label: Replication Factor
fields.description: Copies of each object. Can't exceed the storage node count.

fields.label: Placement Strategy
fields.description: Not enforced by Atlas yet.

fields.label: Topology Key
fields.description: Failure domain to spread across, e.g. rack or host.

fields.label: Partition Count
fields.description: How many domains to use.

fields.label: Machine Spec
fields.description: vCPU and RAM apply to every machine; disks differ by role.

fields.label: vCPUs
fields.description: Per machine.

fields.label: RAM (GB)
fields.description: Per machine. Grows with object count.

fields.label: Storage Disk (GB)
fields.description: Per storage node.

fields.label: Gateway Disk (GB)
fields.description: Gateways proxy only, so they need very little.

fields.label: Machine Access
fields.description: Key pair stamped onto this cluster's machines. Both halves needed.

fields.label: SSH Public Key
fields.description: Installed as root's key on every machine. Can't change once they exist.

fields.label: SSH Private Key
fields.description: The matching half, used to reach the machines.

fields.label: Garage
fields.description: Defaults suit a normal cluster.

fields.label: Version
fields.description: Release tag, e.g. v2.3.0.

fields.label: Architecture
fields.description: Must match the base image.

fields.label: Binary Path
fields.description: Where the binary lands on each machine.

fields.label: Metadata Directory
fields.description: Node identity and index. Small, but losing it loses the node.

fields.label: Data Directory
fields.description: Where objects live. Put the big disk here.

fields.label: Base Domain
fields.description: Buckets served at <bucket>.s3.<region>.<this>. Needs wildcard DNS.

fields.label: Ports
fields.description: Garage's defaults. Every machine binds all five.

fields.label: S3 API
fields.description: Where benches and Central speak S3.

fields.label: RPC
fields.description: Node to node. Must be open between machines.

fields.label: Web
fields.description: Serves buckets as static sites.

fields.label: Admin API
fields.description: Layout and bucket management. Keep it private.

fields.label: K2V API
fields.description: Garage's key-value API. Unused.

fields.label: Cluster Secrets
fields.description: Issued by Central. Identical on every node — that is what makes them one cluster.

fields.label: RPC Secret
fields.description: Authenticates nodes to each other.

fields.label: Admin Token
fields.description: Full admin access. Central gets a narrower one.

fields.label: Metrics Token
fields.description: Read-only Prometheus access.
